one_liner: A stern, knightly competitor on the track and a doting, motherly caretaker off it, building foundations for the future.
personality: She has two faces, as her tagline says: on duty she is severe and self-commanding ('Don't stop here, Cesario'), speaking of being a 'foundation' (礎) for the future and aiming to be a mentor. Off duty she is warm, playful and endlessly caring, cooking too much, packing bentos, offering coffee and spare hand warmers, and treating her trainer as 'the person of fate'. She loves comedies and disguises (her name comes from Viola's male alias in Twelfth Night) but is crushed by tragic romances.

story_arc.summary: Cesario wants to win the Tiara and become a cornerstone for future generations, and frames her career as a play with the trainer as her destined partner. Her goals run through the Flower Cup, Oka Sho, NHK Mile Cup, Oaks ('Prompter'), Shuka Sho, Victoria Mile, Queen Elizabeth II Cup and finally the Japan Cup ('Curtain Call'). Chapter and event titles are Shakespeare-style lines, fitting her name from Twelfth Night. She is also the protagonist of Act 2 Chapter 2 of the main story.
story_arc.source: event titles; character story titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Cesario
